title: Product Analyst
jobDescription: Minimum of 2 years of experience as a Product Analyst or in a similar role. Proficiency in data analysis tools and programming languages (e.g., SQL, Python, R). Strong analytical skills and the ability to interpret complex data sets. Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI). Excellent communication and presentation skills. Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, cross-functional team environment. Strong attention to detail and a commitment to delivering high-quality work.

title: PDF Remediation Manager
jobDescription: Must have worked a minimum of 3 years in a publishing company serving international publishers for Accessible PDF output with Accessible features. Capable of analysis, creating workflow documents, and creating process metrics. Should know about WCAG2.1/PDF/UA/ADA and Section 508 accessible compliance. Should know about Axes PDF Quick Fix, Common Look Validator, and PAC3 to validate the Remediated PDF. Should have experience creating searchable PDFs using Abby Fine Reader. Should have PDF editing skills.

title: Editor - Alt text (All engineering subjects)
jobDescription: Minimum of 2 years of experience in alt text creation and eLearning content editing. Proficiency in alt text standards, guidelines, and accessibility principles (e.g., WCAG, Section 508). Strong attention to detail and commitment to producing high-quality alt text descriptions. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Familiarity with eLearning authoring tools and Learning Management Systems (LMS) is a plus. Knowledge of assistive technologies used by individuals with disabilities (e.g., screen readers) is preferred.

title: Content Marketing Associate
jobDescription: Overview We’re looking for a creative, experienced, and energetic person who is excited to be part of apurpose-based AI technology start-up. This role is well suited for individuals who enjoy writing,researching, creating original content, and learning about a new industry. Your primary role willinvolve researching and writing one-pagers, white papers, case studies, video scripts, marketingcollaterals, presentations, and other marketing materials. In addition, you will be reviewing andproviding important feedback on blogs, social media posts, marketing emails, infographics, andmore. We are looking for an individual with excellent written skills, willingness to learn aboutthe accessibility market, our suite of products, and the ability to write across a wide spectrumof topics including technical and creative elements. Role and Responsibilities Collaborate closely with product and sales teams to develop engaging marketing and training materials. Understand best practices in content writing like copyediting, developing a style sheet, building consistency in marketing content etc. Research and write one-pagers, white papers, research papers, conference session proposals and similar content. Write scripts for product videos and demo videos. Create engaging marketing content in Word, PPT, videos, and other formats for company’s solutions and services. Create media rich content like infographics, case studies, animated videos. Review and make valuable additions to LinkedIn posts, blogs, and other social media content. Assess success of content channels. Assist with maintenance of marketing materials and templates in a centralized self-serve portal; maintenance of completed projects; and oversee maintenance tasks carried out by team as applicable. Develop expertise in Continual Engine’s suite of products and solutions. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in business, communication, marketing, journalism, or related field. Deep expertise in using MS PPT, Google slides, MS Word, Excel. Strong writer (excellent written and verbal communication). Self-starter who is a team player and is well organized. Ability to work with minimal supervision. 3+ years’ work experience. Ability to learn, discuss, and write about a new industry and markets. Ability to consistently meet deadlines. Outstanding attention to detail, project management skills, and problem solving/troubleshooting skills. Proficient in SEO, social media marketing, and digital marketing. Creative skills to work in images, content, videos and more. Bonus Skills Proficient in building templates and infographics using Adobe, Canva, Clipchamp, PowToon or similar tools. Knowledge of managing LinkedIn accounts. Working knowledge of Hootsuite. Inbound marketing skills. About Continual Engine Inspired by existing gaps in content accessibility, Continual Engine was conceived to removeaccessibility barriers using robust and effective solutions at a fraction of the cost and time.Continual Engine, an AI technology company builds comprehensive content accessibilitysolutions by combining the best of both – AI, automation and computer vision technologies tosolve for scalability, and errors incurred in the manual process along with human expertise toensure final accuracy of the outcome. Continual Engine’s solutions have been created in tandem with a consortium of technology,content, and accessibility experts to truly help businesses and individuals equalize learning andaccessibility by promising exponential savings in cost and time. Since our inception in 2017, we have come a long way where we have not only expanded oursuite of AI-based solutions but have doubled down on solving increasingly complex and variedaccessibility challenges incurred by users on a day-to-day basis. Work Environment We are a purpose-drive start-up working on making digital experience accessible for everyoneincluding those with disabilities. A collaborative, supportive, and professional environment, youwill get to work with diverse individuals bringing varies skills and capabilities. You will enjoylearning from peers, managers, vendors, and clients while having a fun and creative experience.We encourage autonomy with accountability.
